column2: [intro]
Grand-Place, vibrant in the rain,
Worn cobblestones, witnesses to all the pain,
Lively cafés, beer flowing freely,
Brussels, all excesses are within reach of me.
Brussels, city of every folly,
In your chaos, I feel so alive and jolly,
The chaos inspires, I lose myself in your streets,
Brussels, it’s a mess, and I love this beat.
The Atomium, symbol of your modern flare,
Busy markets where diversities share,
Languages intertwine in a joyful clamor,
Brussels, your chaos frees me, it's my glamour.
Brussels, city of every folly,
In your chaos, I feel so alive and jolly,
The chaos inspires, I lose myself in your streets,
Brussels, it’s a mess, and I love this beat.
[ solo ]
Brussels, I love you in your imperfections,
Your chaos, a source of inspiration’s reflections,
In this mess, I’ve found my own space,
Brussels, it’s a mess, and it’s my grace.
[outro]
